name: Layout engines
responsibility: Settles cards, frames, routes and labels as one drawing, with the engine the render names: Blocks or Lanes
description: Nothing after it may repair a coordinate. Both engines pack each container and group as a block of its own, rank cards with Graphviz, and route the trunks between blocks with the orthogonal router. Blocks, the default, plans each block's routes before it draws them, and takes the lanes' placement where no plan gives every line a clear channel. Lanes always takes that placement: every line runs on a lane of its own between the ranks. draw states the graph, takes one solve, fits the page to the drawing and settles its crossings. Every variant is laid out fresh (ADR 0032, ADR 0059, ADR 0096).
